snippet.title: Defend Your Dungeon! Infamous Keepers (Reveal Trailer) - Roguelike & Tower Defense
snippet.description:
Welcome to the official Reveal Trailer for Infamous Keepers, the brand-new Tower Defense & Tactical Roguelite set in the acclaimed Legend of Keepers universe! 🏰🔥

👉 Wishlist Infamous Keepers on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4502750/Infamous_Keepers?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=reveal_trailer

Defend your dungeon—and your job! The Dungeon Company has gone through massive layoffs, and your portal has been cut off. Tower Defense meets Roguelite as you step into the role of a Dungeon Manager. Prove your dungeon can still turn a profit by strategically placing traps, commanding your employees, and personally slaughtering any heroes who survive the gauntlet. If a team of heroes makes it through, kiss your career goodbye!

Key Features in Infamous Keepers:

Strengthen Your Defenses: Strategically place deadly towers and traps. Floors, walls—everything is fair game to welcome your "visitors".

Manage Your Dungeon: Make cruel and pragmatic decisions. Recruit monsters, trade resources, or sell your lowest-performing employees into slavery for rare items!

Fight the Survivors: Be the last line of defense. Wait deep in your lair and use your Keeper's unique spells to finish the job yourself.

Evolve to Survive: Face everything from young heroes to mutant rats. Unlock upgrades, use Relics, and adapt your strategy to survive unpredictable random events.

💬 Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/kPVgE5g
🐦 Follow us on Twitter/X for updates: https://x.com/jverbroucht
